description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and pushes lineage to Collibra Data Intelligence Platform via the import/json-job endpoint.

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

catalog_url.label: Collibra Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Collibra base URL (e.g. https://acme.collibra.com). /rest/2.0/import/json-job is appended.

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Env var with the Collibra bearer token.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload and skip push when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_catalog_error.label: Fail on Catalog Error
fail_on_catalog_error.description: If true, fail the run when the catalog is unreachable or PUTs error. Default true.
